title: AI Security and Prompt Injection Defense

questions.question: Why should AI security be addressed before launch?
options: Because prompts, context, tools, and outputs create trust boundaries that need controls
Because model output is always safe
Because tool calls cannot cause harm
questions.explanation: AI workflows introduce trust boundaries that must be understood before production use.

questions.question: Which signal is explicitly part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: Prompt injection is one of the AI security signals.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked security triage plan with controls and rationale
questions.explanation: The artifact supports triage; it does not replace security review.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
questions.explanation: A trust boundary map makes the risk surface visible.

questions.question: When should an AI workflow require a launch gate?
options: When impact, uncertainty, and security signals are high
Only when there is no data
Only when no users are involved
questions.explanation: High-risk AI workflows need explicit launch-gate review.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the reusable checklist?
options: To surface risks and controls before an assistant receives data or tool access
To approve all tool calls automatically
questions.explanation: The checklist supports practical security review before access expands.
